bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
echo GAYBBS_HELP_DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT
printf 'CHECKOUT='; pwd
printf 'REPO_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'REPO_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'DIRTY_FILES='; git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l
printf 'ORIGIN_GAYBBS='; git remote get-url origin | grep -Eq '(^|[:/])seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot(\\.git)?$' && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'HELP_EXISTS='; test -f artifacts/bot/src/bot/operationHelpHandlers.ts && echo YES || echo NO
echo DEPLOY_CANDIDATES
find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*compose*.y*ml' -o -name 'production-start.sh' -o -iname '*deploy*.sh' \) -not -path './node_modules/*' | head -n 25
echo GAYBBS_CONTAINERS
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Image}}|{{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'gaybbs|gateapp|tg[t]?umbler' || true
